QuestInfo.name: [Labyrinth of Suffering] Fading Light
QuestInfo.0: You can still hear desperate screams coming from somewhere, but there's no point in following them. You probably can't save the remaining Alliance members anyway, and you don't have the strength to keep going.
QuestInfo.1: You can still hear desperate screams coming from somewhere, but there's no point in following them. You probably can't save the remaining Alliance members anyway, and you don't have the strength to keep going.
QuestInfo.2: The moment you awoke, you discovered you were in a whole new place. What if you're stuck here forever?
